usage: eventboat repl [--message sample.json] [--cel 'expr' | --script f.star]

flags:
  -cel string
    	evaluate one CEL predicate against the message and exit
  -json
    	machine-readable output for agents and CI (the global --json, also accepted here)
  -message string
    	sample message JSON file (default: {})
  -script string
    	run one Starlark script file against the message and exit
